title: Activation Steering for Aligned Open-ended Generation without Sacrificing Coherence
abstract: arXiv:2604.08169v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Alignment in LLMs is more brittle than commonly assumed: misalignment can be induced by adversarial prompts, benign fine-tuning, emergent misalignment, and goal misgeneralization. Recent evidence suggests that some misalignment behaviors are encoded as linear structure in activation space, making it tractable via activation steering, which could be used as a lightweight runtime defense. We implement three methods: Steer-With-Fixed-Coefficient (SwFC), which applies uniform additive steering, and two novel projection-aware methods, Steer-to-Target-Projection (StTP) and Steer-to-Mirror-Projection (StMP), that use a logistic regression decision boundary to selectively intervene only on tokens whose activations fall below the threshold. translated_title: 针对对齐开放式生成且不牺牲连贯性的激活引导
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.08169v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）中的对齐比通常假设的更脆弱：对抗性提示、良性微调、突发性错位和目标泛化错误都可能诱发错位行为。近期证据表明，一些错位行为在激活空间中编码为线性结构，这使得通过激活引导来处理成为可能，可作为轻量级运行时防御手段。我们实现了三种方法：固定系数引导（SwFC），采用均匀加性引导；以及两种新颖的投影感知方法，即目标投影引导（StTP）和镜像投影引导（StMP），它们使用逻辑回归决策边界，仅对激活低于阈值的标记进行选择性干预。我们在两种威胁模型（不诚实和轻蔑态度）上评估这些方法，使用恶意系统提示作为错位的受控代理。我们在两种架构（Llama）上进行实验。
tldr: 本文提出三种激活引导方法（包括两种新颖的投影感知方法），通过选择性干预低激活标记，在不牺牲连贯性的前提下有效防御LLM中的错位行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three activation steering methods, including two novel projection-aware approaches, to selectively intervene on low-activation tokens, effectively defending against misalignment in LLMs without sacrificing coherence.
